topic: What adaptive coding strategies compensate for non-Gaussian noise statistics in reconciliation phases of CV-QKD over turbulent channels?
consensus_response: The integration of multi-dimensional reconciliation via LDPC codes with Quantum Error Correction Codes (QECCs) offers a novel approach to compensating non-Gaussian noise statistics in CV-QKD over turbulent channels. This hybrid strategy leverages the physical mechanisms underlying QECCs and multi-dimensional reconciliation to correct transmission errors, mitigate time-variant channel properties, and enhance reconciliation efficiency. Adaptive rate LDPC codes with puncturing techniques can balance reconciliation efficiency and decoding complexity, making it suitable for satellite-based CV-QKD applications.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of adapting coding strategies to counteract time-variant channel properties in satellite communications. Multi-dimensional reconciliation via multi-edge LDPC codes is considered a promising approach for low SNRs, while non-deterministic noiseless linear amplification (NDNLA) distills improved CV entanglement.
